name: Manzanares el Real (Spain)
description: Divided into three parts by two diagonal lines, green at the upper hoist and lower fly and yellow in the centre, charged with the arms of Manzanares el Real beneath a count's crown (a bend on green and red with the words AVE MARIA GRATIA PLENA).
history: The arms of Manzanares el Real, timbred with a count's crown, were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 21 December 1993; the flag, approved in 1993, is of proportions 2:3, divided into three parts by two lines, one from the lower hoist corner to the first third of the upper edge.
